title: Well made
text: Well made. Quality, I used them to replace original quart paint cans.

product_metadata.title: Pack of 4-32 Oz Large Clear Empty Plastic Storage Jars with Lids - Square Food Grade Container with Easy Grip Handles - Multi Purpose Jar BPA Free
features: GREAT QUALITY - Made out of hard commercial grade PET plastic that is food safe and has high clarity and is very strong and durable, great replacement for those heavy glass jars that easily crack & break

KEEP’EM FRESH - Container comes with screw on lids that has inner foam liners to ensure a strong and reliable airtight seal, buy in bulk and store into these convenient, classy jars, they will stay fresh for a long time

USE IN THE KITCHEN - Great as pantry organizer for storing goods such as cereals, rice, pastas, nuts, oatmeal, cookies, beans, flour, sugar, popcorn kernels, seeds, powders, jerky, bulk herbs, spices, pickles, mayo and other dry and liquidy foods

OR BEYOND THE KITCHEN - Use these jars all around the house from arts & crafts supplies like buttons, glitters, crayons and pencils to organizing your garage by storing paints, screws, bolts and nails.
ITEM SPECIFICATIONS - 32 Ounce Capacity, 3.6” Width x 5.5” Height, temperature tolerance up to 120°F and is freezer safe. NOT dishwasher safe
